characteristics.$text: Can also be thrown during exchange of missiles.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Fire order to shoot, Heavily Laden

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Flaming wheel, D6 SV6 Fire hits struck on units in its path. (see special rules page 68)

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Can also be 'cracked' during the exchange of missiles.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Fire order to shoot, 3x Ranged SV3

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Overhead, Fire order to shoot, D6 Hits

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Overhead, Fire order to shoot, D6 Hits

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: D6 SV1 Impact hits on charge

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Can also be thrown as ranged weapon.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Fire order to shoot, Fire attacks, D6 hits

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Overhead, Fire order to shoot, D4 hits

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: +1 STR in HtH only, Magically Returns to hand of user if thrown. Can be used in Exchange of Missiles.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: HtH weapon that can be thrown in Exchange of Missiles.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Enemy unit within range and LOS (same as shooting).

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: D3 + casters Magic Level hits caused, resolved at Strike Value 1 and Fire Attacks.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Enemy in Range and LOS (same as shooting attack).

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: D3 + Casters magic level hits, resolved at Strike Value 1 and as a Deathly Chill Ranged Attack. Cannot affect models with Undead or Spectral Undead rule.

characteristics.name: Casting Value
characteristics.$text: 8 minus 1 for every 10" of distance between caster and target.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Unit is removed from current position and repositioned by the OWNING player at the player's table edge or if there is no player's edge then an edge nominated by the caster.

characteristics.name: Range
characteristics.$text: Cast upon Wizard and also automatically affects all friendly units in HtH combat within 10" of the wizard.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: All friendly units within 10" that are fighting HtH combat.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: All models affected by the spell receive a STR bonus of +1 per Magic Level of caster as long as spell is in effect.

characteristics.name: Duration
characteristics.$text: Lasts until the end of turn.  Also immediately ends if the caster moves, attempts to dispel and enemy spell, or is killed. (does NOT end if caster is in HtH fighting)

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Any Friendly unit in range, LOS is NOT required.  Can be cast on wizards own unit.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Any ranged attack upon the unit will automatically miss on any ACC roll other than a 1.  Only affects attacks where an ACC check is made, would not affect things like Fiery balls where no ACC check is made.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Roll a D6 and add Magic Level.  You can remove this total number of pins from the target units.  It does not have to be distributed evenly, you get to decide which pins are removed from where.

characteristics.name: Range
characteristics.$text: 10" for Magic Level 1, 20" for Magic Level 2, 30" for Magic Level 3.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: All enemy units within applicable Range.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Roll a D6 and add Magic Level.  You can distribute this total number of pins amongst the units affected.  You can distribute them however you like, it does NOT have to be evenly.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Friendly Undead warrior unit of either skeletons or zombies with five models or fewer (this includes Skeleton units armed with bows or crossbows).

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Roll a D6 and add casters Magic Level.  This is the number of additional warriors that join the unit. New models have the same weapons.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: All Friendly units within Range, including casters own unit.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Any shooting attack upon a unit affected by spell will automatically miss on any ACC roll other than a 1.

characteristics.name: Duration
characteristics.$text: Lasts until end of the turn.  Also ended immediately if the caster Moves, attempts to dispel an enemy's spell or is killed.

characteristics.name: Range
characteristics.$text: 10" (for undead wizards and necromancers the range is 10" per magic level).

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Any friendly unit that has one or more order dice played already that turn.  LOS is NOT required.  Cannot be cast on casters own unit.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: One order dice is removed from the unit and returned to the dice bag.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Any unit in Range, NO LOS necessary.  If cast on unit with multiple models, pick the specific model that is the target.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Causes 1 hit.  Roll a D3 and add casters Magic Level, this is the SV of the bolt.   Once hit has been resolved and a pin has been added for being hit by a ranged missile, the unit must take a BREAK TEST.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: An enemy unit of monsters or a monstrosity within Range and LOS (same as shooting attack).

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: If the unit has any order dice remaining in dice bag, take them all from the bag at once and give them to the unit as DOWN orders.  Any order dice already on the unit are instead changed to DOWN.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: All enemy units in HtH combat within 10" of caster.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: All models affected by the spell receive a STR penalty of -1 per magic level of caster and no enemy may make more than 1 attack during HtH fighting.

characteristics.name: Duration
characteristics.$text: Lasts until end of turn, also ends immediately if the caster moves, attempts to dispel an enemy's spell or is Killed.

characteristics.name: Target
characteristics.$text: Opposing Wizard Unit.  NO LOS necessary.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Each Wizard rolls a D6 and adds their Magic Level.  Highest total wins. The loser suffers a pin.  The winner can then decide whether to continue the duel or end it.  Repeat until a wizards reaches their pin break point or the winner declares an end to the spell.  If the results are a tie at any time then both wizards receive a pin and the duel continues.

sharedProfiles.name: Hanbo, Cane, Scroll or Tea Service

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: No damage. See Bolas special rule.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Can be used for exchange of missiles

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Exchange of missiles only. SV2 on first use in a game.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Exchange of missiles only. No Damage - see Net special rule.

sharedRules.name: Tough 1
sharedRules.description: Re-roll a failed RES test. Only one failed RES test can be re-rolled at a time from a single shooting/HTH attack.

sharedRules.name: Wound 1
sharedRules.description:
Model can sustain 1 wound instead of dying immediately.
Each sustained wound counts as a permanent pin that can't be removed.
Unit can still be auto-destroyed by pins.

sharedRules.name: Magic Level 1
sharedRules.description: Spell Caster/Wizard Level 1.

sharedRules.name: Tough 2
sharedRules.description: Re-roll two failed RES tests from a single attack. A die may only be re-rolled once, you must accept the second result.

sharedRules.name: Zealous
sharedRules.description: Ignore pins when taking a break test. Re-Roll failed order test.

sharedRules.name: Heavily Laden
sharedRules.description: Cannot Sprint.

sharedRules.name: Magic Level 2
sharedRules.description: Spell Caster/Wizard Level 2.

sharedRules.name: Magic Level 3
sharedRules.description: Spell Caster/Wizard Level 3.

sharedRules.name: Spirit
sharedRules.description: Can be sacrificed for a reroll. Destroyed if wizard is slain.

sharedRules.name: Deadeye Shot
sharedRules.description: Re-roll one missed shooting attack.

sharedRules.name: Pavise
sharedRules.description: Cannot be given Run order. -3 Agility. Counts as in cover with +2 Res bonus.

sharedRules.name: Surly
sharedRules.description: Cannot benefit from Command, Hero abilities.

sharedRules.name: Large
sharedRules.description: Can draw LOS to body. +1 to hit when shooting at model. Can draw LOS over non-large models.

sharedRules.name: Insufferably Sactimonious
sharedRules.description: Increase from Tough to Tough 2.

sharedRules.name: Command
sharedRules.description: Friendly units within 10" can use the model's CO stat to take command based tests.

sharedRules.name: Divine Intervention
sharedRules.description:
Can steal an order dice from an enemy unit within 20" with a successful Command test and use it itself immediately.
If it fails, take 1 pin instead. 
Max 1 attempt per turn per Warband regardless of success.
If successful, unit that the die was stolen from counts as having received an order.

sharedRules.name: Wound 2
sharedRules.description:
Model can sustain 2 wounds instead of dying immediately.
Each sustained wound counts as a permanent pin that can't be removed.
Unit can still be auto-destroyed by pins.

sharedRules.name: Challenge
sharedRules.description: May initiate a 'Challenge to the death'.

sharedRules.name: Tough 3
sharedRules.description: Re-roll three failed RES tests from a single attack. A die may only be re-rolled once, you must accept the second result.

sharedRules.name: Wound 3
sharedRules.description:
Model can sustain 3 wounds instead of dying immediately.
Each sustained wound counts as a permanent pin that can't be removed.
Unit can still be auto-destroyed by pins.

sharedRules.name: Hero
sharedRules.description: Friendly units within 10" can use the model's Init stat to take Reaction tests.

sharedRules.name: Follow
sharedRules.description:
Friendly un-pinned units within 5" can follow the unit's order immediately.
Draw an order die for each unit following.
Move the initiating unit first and resolve its action, then do the same for each unit following.

sharedRules.name: Frenzied Charge
sharedRules.description: +1 Extra Attack when charging. Bonus attacks are never doubled, e.g. via Berserk.

sharedRules.name: Savage
sharedRules.description: Reroll all misses in first round of combat in game.

sharedRules.name: Irresistible Charge
sharedRules.description: D3 SV bonus when charging. Does not apply in follow-on combat round.

sharedRules.name: Flies
sharedRules.description:
Move over any terrain/obstacle without test or penalty. 
Can move through friendly or enemy units.
Enemy cannot charge/countercharge or follow-on in combat unless they can also fly or unless flyers are down.
Flying machines are auto-destroyed if going Down over impassable terrain.
Reroll all shooting hits against flyers.
Cannot be hit by overhead weapons unless they are Down.

sharedRules.name: Vengeful
sharedRules.description:
If unit wins the first round of close combat then it MUST elect to fight a follow on combat where it can do so.
In follow-on combat unit fights with double attacks.

sharedRules.name: Undead
sharedRules.description:
Cannot be routed.
Auto-resist choking attacks.
Ignore bonus hits from Venomous attacks.
Immune to Dread.
Immune to Terror.

sharedRules.name: Zombie Master
sharedRules.description: Can use Hero/Follow/Command rules for Zombie units.

sharedRules.name: Spectral Undead
sharedRules.description:
In addition to Undead rule, hits from flaming attacks are auto-resisted and inflict no extra pins.
All difficult ground/obstacles count as open terrain for movement.

sharedRules.name: Deathly Chill
sharedRules.description: Attacks ignore armour.

sharedRules.name: Dread
sharedRules.description:
-1 to hit shooting and HtH.
-1 to break test if defeated by enemy with Dread.
Unaffected by opponents with Dread.

sharedRules.name: Zombie
sharedRules.description:
A failed order test is an advance order and not down.  
Cannot sprint.
Must test Agility after Run order.
Cannot benefit from the Hero/Follow/Command unless character is Zombie Master.

sharedRules.name: Slow
sharedRules.description: Move at the basic rate indicated.

sharedRules.name: Fast
sharedRules.description:
Move at the basic rate indicated.
Reroll shooting hits against unit if it has a Run order.

sharedRules.name: Howling Horror Ammunition
sharedRules.description: Target suffers D3 additional pins. Affects Undead.

sharedRules.name: Unstoppable
sharedRules.description:
Shot penetrates the unit hit and can strike others beyond so long as the target is hit each time.
Monstrosities roll twice on the damage chart for each hit from an Unstoppable weapon.

sharedRules.name: Undead Army Special Rule
sharedRules.description: If your warlord is slain, then no further pins are removed from your units. Orders can still be issued as normal.

sharedRules.name: Disciplined
sharedRules.description:
Lose all pins when passing a Rally test. 
Routing units lose all pins if passing a Command test due to nearby units making a Rally order.

sharedRules.name: Shieldwall
sharedRules.description:
Can only be used if all models in unit touch base with another model to lock shields.
Cannot sprint and suffer -1 Agility and Initiative. 
Enemy suffers -1 to hit in ranged and HtH.

sharedRules.name: Berserk
sharedRules.description: Until defeated or fail a break test: double attacks in HtH and automatically pass orders to charge including reactions.

sharedRules.name: MoD2
sharedRules.description: Unit has 2 Order Dice. See page 56 for rules.

sharedRules.name: Rapid Sprint
sharedRules.description: Sprint at 4M.

sharedRules.name: Stampede
sharedRules.description:
Stampede on failed order test of 10. D10"+2M in direction shown by dice.
Each unit in path and within 1" of final location is trampled on (counts as being charged).
Unit goes down and gains 1 pin per unit trampled.

sharedRules.name: Crazed Psychotics
sharedRules.description: Automatically pass charge orders. Cannot be routed. Immune to Dread and Terror.

sharedRules.name: Drop
sharedRules.description: Drop attacks ignore cover modifiers.

sharedRules.name: Fire
sharedRules.description: Fire attacks add an extra pin to targets they hit.

sharedRules.name: Mechanical Genius
sharedRules.description:
Add +1 ACC to all artillery attacks in 10". 
+/-1 for any Monstrosity (machine) damage chart result within 10".

sharedRules.name: Ramshackle Contraption
sharedRules.description: On a failed order result of a 10 roll on the Monstrosity damage chart.

sharedRules.name: Stubborn
sharedRules.description: Remove +1 pin if order test is successful.

sharedRules.name: Enchanted Steed
sharedRules.description:
All water terrain counts as open terrain and adds +1 RES to mounted units.
Reroll failed RES tests against shooting attacks (does not apply to chariots).

sharedRules.name: Haughty Disdain
sharedRules.description: Automatically pass first Break Test in the game.

sharedRules.name: Woodsman
sharedRules.description: Wooded terrain counts as open terrain. +1 RES cover bonus in wooden terrain.

sharedRules.name: Stealthy
sharedRules.description: Re-roll shooting hits against unit if in cover.

sharedRules.name: Baleful Glare
sharedRules.description: Ranged Attack 20". No damage but inflicts 1+D3 pins and unit takes a Break test.

sharedRules.name: Venomous
sharedRules.description: Add one hit if any hits are scored.

sharedRules.name: Flaming Breath
sharedRules.description: Ranged Attack 20". Fire Attack (+1 pin). As Stats.

sharedRules.name: Blundering
sharedRules.description: Cannot Sprint. Must test Agility for a Run action. Crosses obstacles as chariot/artillery.

sharedRules.name: Regenerate
sharedRules.description: Must re-roll one failed RES test per attack and take pin if successful. Does not work against Fire attacks.

sharedRules.name: Beastly Breath
sharedRules.description: D6 Ranged attacks, 20", SV3 Choking.

sharedRules.name: Chunder
sharedRules.description: Ranged Attack 10". Opponent's RES is always 5.  Chunder goes empty on a roll of 6+.

sharedRules.name: Terror
sharedRules.description:
A unit within 15" removes NO pins when making an order test. 
A unit failing a break test within 5" is automatically destroyed.
A routing unit within 5" is automatically destroyed.
Terrifying units and units with the Crazed Psychotic/Undead rules are immune to terror.

sharedRules.name: Choking
sharedRules.description: No armour bonus or cover bonus allowed.

sharedRules.name: Allied
sharedRules.description: Cannot benefit from Command, Hero, or Follow special rules.

sharedRules.name: Bound
sharedRules.description:
Cannot benefit from Command, Hero, or Follow special rules.
Take D6 pins if a 10 is rolled for its order test. Can be auto-destroyed via pins as a result.

sharedRules.name: Flaming Wheel
sharedRules.description:
Max move of 1M.
Difficult terrain and obstacles count as impassable.
Fire order to shoot (or rather push).

sharedRules.name: MoD3
sharedRules.description: Unit has 3 Order Dice.

sharedRules.name: Slow 3
sharedRules.description: Move at a base rate of 3".

sharedRules.name: Slow 4
sharedRules.description: Move at a base rate of 4".

sharedRules.name: Fast 6
sharedRules.description:
Move at a base rate of 6".
Reroll shooting hits against unit if it has a Run order.

sharedRules.name: Fast 8
sharedRules.description:
Move at a base rate of 8".
Reroll shooting hits against unit if it has a Run order.

sharedRules.name: Fast 10
sharedRules.description:
Move at a base rate of 10".
Reroll shooting hits against unit if it has a Run order.

sharedRules.name: Whirling Dervishes
sharedRules.description:
Loose unit formation: Stay at least 1" apart, max 2".
Can only be given Run order (including Sprint).
On result of 10 for order test, move randomly. Touching other units counts as charge.
Re-roll all shooting hits on unit.
Enemies don't attack in close combat. Saved hits (successful RES rolls) count as casualties for the dervish unit.
Unit is automatically destroyed if close combat is not won.
Consolidation move is random, may initiate immediate combat if touching different unit than that just fought. 
May make consolidation move through unit it just fought.

sharedRules.name: Wild
sharedRules.description:
Goes wild if 10 is rolled for order test.
Add D6 pins to check for auto-destruction as normal. If not auto-destroyed, remove all pins.
Replace all order dice by one die of different color.
When order die is drawn, players dice for control.

sharedRules.name: Warhorse
sharedRules.description:
Cancels Heavily Laden.
Restores Agility and Initiative to previous values (usually included in the stat line).

sharedRules.name: Overhead
sharedRules.description:
Uses 3" template. All units under template are hit, divide hits evenly between units. 
Allocate hits first to models under template then to others in unit.
On miss, roll D10 to deviate: move template as many inches in direction shown by die. 
When shooting blind (without LOS): Hits on a 1, misses are ignored and have no effect.

sharedRules.name: Fire Order to Shoot
sharedRules.description: Requires Fire Order to shoot. Does not gain +1 to hit from Aimed Shot.

sharedRules.name: Ferocious Charge
sharedRules.description: +1 to strength when charging. Does not apply to follow-on combat.

sharedRules.name: Fast 7
sharedRules.description:
Move at a base rate of 7".
Reroll shooting hits against unit if it has a Run order.

sharedRules.name: Bolas
sharedRules.description:
Bola attacks do not cause damage but do cause a pin.
If used against a Warrior unit, test against sum of hits. 
If successful one enemy model of shooters choice does not fight back including follow-on combat.

sharedRules.name: Cold-Eyed
sharedRules.description:
When testing against Command, ignore one pin the unit has.
Order tests still require a successful test even if unit only has one pin.

sharedRules.name: Aquatic
sharedRules.description:
Water terrain counts as open terrain.
Re-roll all shooting hits against unit if in water terrain.

sharedRules.name: Net
sharedRules.description:
Can only be used during exchange of missiles.
Rete attacks do not cause damage, but do cause a pin.
If used against a Warrior or Mounted unit, test against sum of hits. 
If successful one enemy model of shooters choice does not fight back including follow-on combat.

sharedRules.name: Pack
sharedRules.description:
Use highest CO stat of any Pack Master within 10".
If Pack Master moves out of range while unit has pins equal to or higher than original CO and it already has taken an action, it is auto-broken.
Same if unit hasn't taken action but receives additional pins before activation.
Otherwise allowed to take an action as normal.

sharedRules.name: Pack Master
sharedRules.description: Units with Pack rule can use this model's CO stat while model is within 10".

sharedRules.name: Upgraded Warlock Attacks
sharedRules.description: Give Warlock 2x HtH SV1 Venomous attacks.
